verdict.rationale: CDP ships first-party natural-language surfaces for AI assistants. These are an MCP server in the CDP CLI (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool, a Wallet MCP that lets any AI check balances, send funds and swap, and Agentic Wallet skills whose triggers are written as user intents ("Use when you or the user want to send money, pay someone..."). There is no built-in natural-language console, though; interpretation depends on the user's own AI assistant, and the skills mostly cover wallet functions rather than the custodial payments product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface within the product, documented natural-language coverage of custodial payment acceptance, payouts and fiat rails beyond raw MCP endpoint exposure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The CDP CLI includes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool.
Coinbase Wallet MCP connects any AI to your Coinbase Wallet. Check balances, send funds, swap tokens, sign messages, and pay with x402.
Use when you or the user want to send money, pay someone, transfer USDC, tip, donate, or send funds to a wallet address or .eth name.
Once installed, your agent gains wallet capabilities with no additional wiring required.
